description: Screenshot a web page on several devices at once to see how its layout responds. Returns one labelled image per device. Defaults to a phone, a tablet and a laptop. Set fullPage to capture the whole page (cut off at 6000px).

devices.description: Device ids or names from list_devices ("iphone-17", "Galaxy S26"), free-form sizes ("1024x768"), or a preset: default, popular, phones, latest, tablets, desktops, apple, foldables, extremes.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, not only the first screen

url.description: Page to load: a full URL, a bare host such as example.com, localhost:3000 for a local dev server, or a path to an HTML file

name: screenshot
